title: Appropriations.
bodyText: The governor may include in the governor's operating budget such sums as the governor deems necessary for the continuation and operations of the program.
bodyHtml: §29-3  Appropriations.  The governor may include in the governor's operating budget such sums as the governor deems necessary for the continuation and operations of the program. [L 1965, c 237, pt of §3; Supp, §12A-3; HRS §29-3; gen ch 1985]
